Short answers up front: yes, Private (VPC) is available for PHI and can be provisioned as a customer-managed deployment; and yes, we can configure the Hosted PoC so that logs, KV cache, and model outputs do not leave the selected region. I'll summarize below and propose exact MAP milestones.

Technical notes (high level):
- Hosted PoC: runs in us-west-2 (we can pin region). We will enable regional-only logging and disable cross-region backups for the PoC window.
- Private: full VPC deployment with KMS integration and customer-managed key (HSM option) — best for long-term PHI production.
- Dedicated: reserved GPU pool in your tenant for predictable throughput; option to add a private network boundary (dedicated VPC peering).

Proposed MAP (dates are draft):
- Jan 12–26: PoC on Hosted (us-west-2) — success criteria: latency < 250ms p95, cost per 1k tokens within target range, no PII/PHI exfiltration in logs
- Jan 27–Feb 9: Acceptance sprint and security sign-off (legal/procurement)
- Feb 10–Mar 31: Provision Dedicated capacity and migrate production traffic; option to schedule Private deployment cutover if legal requires

I've updated the MAP in Drive and attached an annotated PDF (hearth_map_v2.pdf). Karthik / Marissa — can you confirm capacity availability in us-west-2 for a Dedicated pool and an estimate for reserved commit sizing?

Samir / Rachel — adding a quick operations note. We do have capacity in us-west-2 for a small Dedicated pool that can be ready within 10 business days after commit. High level tradeoffs:

- Hosted PoC (fastest): minimal config, pins to us-west-2. Good for validating latency and quality. No hardware commit.
- Dedicated (recommended for production): reserved GPUs, better tail latency due to exclusive capacity, supports autoscaling and burst buffer.
- Private (VPC/on-prem): highest compliance but longest lead time (network peering, KMS setup, SOC/attestation).

Suggested approach:
1) Run PoC on Hosted in us-west-2 for 2 weeks to validate prompts and metrics.
2) If PoC metrics pass, 1-week acceptance + contract commit for Dedicated (we can pre-reserve capacity to hit the 10-day window).
3) If legal mandates Private, provision VPC after acceptance (30–45 day lead time for HSM/KMS and network).

Attachment: capacity_profile_us-west-2.pdf (PDF) — shows available GPU types and baseline latency.

Karthik
Head of Infrastructure | Redwood Inference
